clips.title: The story
paras: In Alterac, recruits face a trial before joining the Stormpike Guard. Lieutenant Haggerdin sends them into Icewing Caverns to recover a planted battle standard. Success earns an official Stormpike Insignia and begins their rise through the expedition’s ranks.

The Stormpike Guard fights the Frostwolf Clan in Alterac Valley. Lieutenant Haggerdin directs Alliance forces from their encampment in the Alterac Mountains. He tests new recruits before sending them to the battlefield, demanding proof of skill and nerve in Icewing Caverns, southwest of Dun Baldar.

A Stormpike banner waits deep in the icy tunnels of Icewing Caverns. Frost harpies nest in the frozen recesses and attack unwary trespassers. Bringing back the banner intact shows a recruit can cross dangerous ground, face the predators, and keep discipline under pressure.

Returning from the caverns with the standard earns a soldier the Stormpike initiate’s insignia and a place in the expeditionary force. Haggerdin promises that the insignia can be improved as a soldier earns greater honor on the battlefield, with honors such as the Eye of Command as a distant aim.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You've arrived just in time, adventurer. These Frostwolf savages just won't give up! We must show them the might of the Stormpike. They must bow to our superiority.
Before you make your way to the field of battle, you will want to join the rank of Stormpike.

Southwest of Dun Baldar, you will find the Icewing Caverns. Planted deep within the caverns is a Stormpike Banner. Venture forth and recover that banner. Return it to me, and you will have earned a Stormpike initiate's insignia.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Beware the harpies of the region, adventurer. They'll not think twice to rip out your throat!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Take and wear this insignia with pride, friend. As your rank among the Stormpike grows, so too will the insignia. Return to me as you gain honor with Stormpike, and I shall replace your insignia with other, more powerful insignias.
Perhaps someday you will grow to be a legend on this field of battle. Should that day ever come, you will be granted the Eye of Command.
